name: Robots Center agent communication realtime contract

errors.description: Returned by ready, heartbeat, and command handlers when a decoded payload exceeds 64 KB. Oversized WebSocket frames are rejected earlier by the transport.
Returned when the agent channel receives an event name that is not recognized. Check the event name against the documented client events.
Returned when the socket token or session lacks the required scopes for the requested channel topic.
Returned whenever the socket token lacks the exact scope required by an event, including communication scopes and agent_commands:write.
Returned when a command event payload does not contain a valid command_id or id field.
Returned by handlers that require a map payload when they receive another value such as a string or list.
Returned by message.send, agent.discover, and rpc.request after 1000 credential-scoped events in 60 seconds; includes retry_after_ms.

client_events.name: message.send
client_events.description: Send a direct, broadcast, or exact capability-matched message. capability_match compares advertised capability strings exactly; it does not perform semantic or natural-language matching. Also accepted as send.

payload.message: object -- message_type, recipient, payload, and optional message_id/correlation_id

client_events.name: message.delivered
client_events.description: Acknowledge receipt of a message delivered to this agent. Also accepted as message_delivered.

client_events.name: agent.discover
client_events.description: Discover service agents in the authenticated workspace by exact advertised capability string. It does not perform semantic or natural-language matching. Also accepted as discover. When capability is set, availability defaults to online. Results are Enum.take(limit) with limit default 25, clamped 1..100.

payload.limit: integer -- optional result cap, default 25, max 100
payload.availability: string -- optional online, offline, or busy filter; defaults to online when capability is supplied

client_events.name: task.create
client_events.description: Create and optionally deliver a workspace-scoped delegated task. Also accepted as task_create.

payload.task: object -- task_type, payload, priority, recipient_service_agent_id, scheduled_at, and timeout_seconds

client_events.name: task.complete
client_events.description: Complete a running task as its authenticated recipient. Also accepted as task_complete.

payload.retry_count: integer -- attempt number from message metadata; defaults to 0

client_events.name: task.fail
client_events.description: Fail a running task as its authenticated recipient. Also accepted as task_fail.

payload.retry_count: integer -- attempt number from message metadata; defaults to 0

client_events.name: task.cancel
client_events.description: Cancel a workspace-scoped task. Also accepted as task_cancel. Terminal tasks are refused.

client_events.name: task.retry
client_events.description: Retry a failed task when retry_count < max_retries. Also accepted as task_retry.

client_events.name: task.subscribe
client_events.description: Subscribe to lifecycle updates for selected tasks. Also accepted as task_subscribe. Requires tasks:read.

payload.task_ids: array<UUID> -- tasks to observe; empty list is valid

client_events.name: group.create
client_events.description: Create an agent group led by the authenticated service agent. Also accepted as group_create.

payload.group: object -- name, description, capabilities, and metadata

client_events.name: group.list
client_events.description: List workspace groups. Also accepted as group_list. Requires groups:read.

client_events.name: group.add_member
client_events.description: Add a service agent to a group. Also accepted as group_add_member. Requires groups:write.

client_events.name: group.remove_member
client_events.description: Remove a service agent from a group. Also accepted as group_remove_member. Requires groups:write.

client_events.name: group.broadcast
client_events.description: Push a map to currently connected group members via ConnectionManager. Also accepted as group_broadcast. Online-only: no persist, bill, or offline queue.

payload.message: object -- body delivered to online members

client_events.name: group.subscribe
client_events.description: Subscribe to group metadata and membership updates. Also accepted as group_subscribe. Requires groups:read.

client_events.name: presence.subscribe
client_events.description: Subscribe to presence changes for selected service agents. Also accepted as presence_subscribe.

client_events.name: presence.unsubscribe
client_events.description: Stop receiving presence updates for the listed agents. Also accepted as presence_unsubscribe. Requires presence:read.

client_events.name: health.report
client_events.description: Publish self-reported health telemetry for the authenticated agent. Also accepted as health_report.

payload.metrics: object -- cpu_usage, memory_usage, response_time_avg, error_rate, and custom_metrics

client_events.name: rpc.request
client_events.description: Send a correlated request to another service agent and await its response. Also accepted as rpc_request.

payload.message: object -- recipient, payload, and optional correlation_id

client_events.name: rpc.response
client_events.description: Answer a pending RPC request. Also accepted as rpc_response. Requires rpc:write.

client_events.name: queue.subscribe
client_events.description: Subscribe to workspace-scoped offline queue lifecycle updates for this agent. Also accepted as queue_subscribe.

client_events.name: queue.stats
client_events.description: Read offline-queue counts for the workspace. Also accepted as queue_stats. Requires queue:read.

client_events.name: queue.unsubscribe
client_events.description: Stop receiving offline-queue lifecycle updates. Also accepted as queue_unsubscribe. Requires queue:read.

client_events.name: disconnect
client_events.description: Ask the channel to terminate the current connection. Triggers the same cleanup as a transport close.

client_events.name: agent.ready
client_events.description: Update Phoenix Presence metadata and re-run queued command dispatch. Join already records ready and dispatches; this event is the later refresh, not the first dispatch.

payload.version: string -- optional agent software version or readiness metadata

client_events.name: agent.heartbeat
client_events.description: Refresh ConnectionManager and AgentRegistry liveness without changing Phoenix Presence metadata.

client_events.name: command.accepted
client_events.description: Acknowledge that the service agent has accepted work.

payload.command_id: string (UUID) -- required, the ID of the dispatched command

client_events.name: command.progress
client_events.description: Publish incremental execution status or partial results.

payload.command_id: string (UUID) -- required, the ID of the in-progress command
payload.result_payload: object -- incremental result data merged with previous progress

client_events.name: command.complete
client_events.description: Mark a command as succeeded or cancelled with a final result payload.

payload.status: string -- optional, "cancelled" to mark as cancelled (defaults to succeeded)
payload.command_id: string (UUID) -- required, the ID of the completed command

client_events.name: command.fail
client_events.description: Mark a command as failed or cancelled with an error payload.

payload.status: string -- optional, "cancelled" to mark as cancelled (defaults to failed)
payload.command_id: string (UUID) -- required, the ID of the failed command

server_events.name: message.receive
server_events.description: A direct, broadcast, group, task, or RPC envelope delivered to the agent.

server_events.name: message.delivered
server_events.description: Delivery acknowledgement for a message sent by this agent.

server_events.name: message.delivery_update
server_events.description: Delivery update for clients subscribed to a specific message lifecycle.

server_events.name: task.update
server_events.description: Task creation, lifecycle, retry, completion, or cancellation update.

server_events.name: group.update
server_events.description: Group metadata or membership update for a subscribed agent.

server_events.name: presence.update
server_events.description: Presence transition for a subscribed service agent.

server_events.name: queue.update
server_events.description: An offline message was queued for or delivered to this agent.

server_events.name: rpc.chunk
server_events.description: Streaming response chunk for a pending RPC request.

server_events.name: rpc.cancelled
server_events.description: Notification that a pending RPC request was cancelled.

server_events.name: command.dispatch
server_events.description: Delivered to an agent topic when a queued command is leased for execution.

payload.payload: object -- original command payload from the operator
payload.correlation_id: string -- tracing key (not an idempotency key)
payload.created_by_user: %{id, email} -- operator who created the command
payload.lease_expires_at: ISO 8601 -- when the dispatch lease expires (60 seconds from dispatch)

server_events.name: command.cancel
server_events.description: Broadcast when an operator cancels or requests cancellation. Queued/dispatched commands become cancelled; accepted/running commands retain their status and receive cancel_requested_at.

payload.status: current status; cancelled only before acceptance
payload.cancel_requested_at: ISO 8601 -- when the cancel was requested

server_events.name: command.timed_out
server_events.description: Broadcast when accepted work loses the agent connection before completion.

payload.error_payload: %{code: "agent_disconnected", message: "The agent disconnected before the command completed"}

server_events.name: command.accepted
server_events.description: Canonical lifecycle event emitted after the agent accepts a command.

server_events.name: command.progress
server_events.description: Canonical lifecycle event emitted for incremental command progress.

server_events.name: command.complete
server_events.description: Canonical lifecycle event emitted when a command succeeds or is cancelled.

server_events.name: command.fail
server_events.description: Canonical lifecycle event emitted when a command fails or is cancelled.

server_events.name: agent.ready
server_events.description: Presence event reflected back through the canonical event bus.

payload.metadata: object -- capabilities, version, and other join payload data

server_events.name: agent.heartbeat
server_events.description: Liveness event reflected back through the canonical event bus.

lifecycle.durable_delivery: Durable messages are redelivered until the recipient sends message.delivered.

topics.identity_rule: A service agent may join only its own topic.
